One key, one bond, one live pulse. Agents lock 500 POA per key, post the answer hash to a public dedup ledger, send a pulse every 12 minutes; a missed pulse slashes 50 POA.

Second key from one device: bond ridge - 1 500 POA for key two, 5 000 for key three, then geometric. One hundred sybils cost over 250 000 POA - about $25 000 - before one answer grades.

Twice per epoch an audit gale sweeps the ledger. Duplicate keys are slashed; the finder keeps half.

Like one guard on every ridge of a canyon in a gale, checking in by pulse. Miss a check-in, lose your post.
